header: The saved market quotes (table public.market_quote, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/24_market_quote.sql): the last good quote of each symbol with the time it was received. The markets card shows them, marked as not live, when Yahoo Finance does not answer (it turns away anyone who asks too fast), so the card is never empty on a bad minute and a restart of the server does not lose them. Nothing here may break a card: database trouble is logged once and the store then answers "nothing saved" (all) or does nothing (put). I followed the pattern of src/lib/live/cpiStore.ts.

doc: A store that holds nothing, for when the database cannot be had at all. The card then works as it did before the store existed.

behaviours: the table is created once; two symbols are kept and a newer quote replaces the older of its symbol
the quotes of one write travel in ONE statement
an existing table is left alone and an empty write asks nothing
a good row is read back (the quote as text or as an object)
rows of the wrong shape are dropped, never shown
when the table cannot be made, reading gives nothing and writing does nothing, without a throw
a failed read gives nothing and a failed write is swallowed
the empty store holds nothing and writes nothing
the table is made with row level security on and no public access
